correctness.rationale: The complete facet description gives x_i>=1 and sum_I x_i<=U_k; the ball radius adds sqrt(k) slack. Averaging subset constraints proves r<=R_k; the center (1+r)1 attains every constraint, and equality forces its uniqueness. Monotone consecutive crossover thresholds T_j construct each unique k; checked n=3 b=(100,3,50) gives R2< R1,R3. Redundant n-1 inequalities when b1=1 have R_n<R_(n-1). This is an all-n proof, not extrapolation from finite tests.
